parameters.content:
W5: weekly analytics digest. NOT active.

Counts finished sessions by closed answers, from the view bev_sessions_flat. Sample sessions are excluded. Any cell under 5 is hidden. It reads counts only: no row, no id, no client_session leaves the database.

To go live: (1) run by hand and read 'Digest'. (2) Replace the last grey node with a mail node to the team. (3) Switch the schedule on.
Not in the digest yet: cohort (the app does not send one yet).

parameters.query: select id from bev_jobs where id = 'analytics-digest' and enabled

select 'sessions' as metric, null::text as a, null::text as b, count(*)::int as n from bev_sessions_flat where stage = 'final' and not from_sample
union all
select 'barrier_ending', barrier, ending, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat where stage = 'final' and not from_sample and barrier is not null group by barrier, ending
union all
select 'unclear', unclear, null, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat where stage = 'final' and not from_sample and unclear is not null group by unclear
union all
select 'frame', keep_years::text, ending, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat where stage = 'final' and not from_sample and keep_years is not null group by keep_years, ending
union all
select 'cohort', cohort, null, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat where stage = 'final' and not from_sample and cohort is not null group by cohort
union all
select 'action', a, null, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat, unnest(actions) as a where stage = 'final' and not from_sample group by a
union all
select 'fact_opened', f, null, count(*)::int from bev_sessions_flat, unnest(facts_opened) as f where stage = 'final' and not from_sample group by f
union all
select 'gap', g, null, count(*)::int from bev_gap_sessions, unnest(gap_codes) as g group by g
union all
select 'move_outcome', o, null, count(*)::int from bev_gap_sessions, unnest(move_outcomes) as o group by o
union all
select 'classifier', via || ' / ' || band, lang || ', accepted ' || accepted_pct || '%', suggestions from bev_classifier_stats

nodes.name: Send digest to team (wire a mail node)

parameters.query: insert into bev_job_runs (job_id, ok, rows_written, summary) values ('analytics-digest', $1, $2, $3) returning id

main.node: Send digest to team (wire a mail node)
